1160	He says, he asks the question there in Torah Or.	Ele diz, ele faz a pergunta ali no Torah Or.
1161	Why did Yaakov Avinu, when he returned to the Land and met Esav, bow to him seven times?	Por que Yaakov Avinu, quando voltou à Terra e encontrou Essav, se prostrou diante dele sete vezes?
1162	What is the reason?	Qual é o motivo?

1166	The Baal HaTanya says as follows: Yaakov Avinu knew that his task, his work, his mission in the world,	O Baal HaTanya diz o seguinte: Yaakov Avinu sabia que a tarefa dele, o trabalho dele, a missão dele no mundo,
1167	was to correct the whole secret of the breaking of the vessels, which is called the correction of the world of Atzilut.	era corrigir todo o segredo da quebra dos vasos, que se chama a correção do mundo de Atzilut.
1168	And HaShem revealed to him that in those years, when he was in the yeshivah of Shem, and afterwards in Charan, he corrected everything	E HaShem lhe revelou que, naqueles anos, quando esteve na yeshivá de Shem e depois em Charan, ele corrigiu tudo

1176	Esav's.	De Essav.
